scope: Public Big Buck Bunny page in isolated Edge with original extension capture, actual native host and C++ transfer objects. Desktop arm/apply actions use a test probe; no account cookies or resolver subprocess.

checks.name: Edge connects to the candidate native direct-refresh capability
Trusted public YouTube panel click captures video/audio using direct
Real direct transfer pauses with retained bytes
A fresh public browser capture is staged on the same paused download
Refreshed public direct capture resumes and produces 360p video with audio

limitations: One public video at 360p, not all YouTube qualities or all platforms.
Desktop refresh arm/apply uses a native C++ probe, not rendered desktop-dialog clicks.
No IDM side-by-side speed comparison; elapsed time covers resume-to-completion only.
